static_call_graph.boundary: AST/import/call-signature/kernel-export checks. Dynamic receiver, inheritance, PyTorch __call__, tensor shapes and CUDA execution are not proven by this graph.

verified_boundaries: Default controller is no-write/no-network/no-data/no-inference-import pure planning; explicit execute is required.
Both methods share one prepared tensor mapping across all arms; before/after tensor fingerprints checked.
All selection uses fixed private model-level RNG rankings, with model RNG/cache state reset per arm.
Original global count and effective distinct merge count are independently recomputed; classification, per-head budgets, candidates and baseline masks paired.
Hybrid work differences are kept; Snap matched candidate/cache/effective-work contract preserved.
Original image metrics, strict coverage/hash checks, negative paired differences and seed sample SD tested.
CPU model-double stream passes real audit and scoring; failures/mutation/ineffective merge never commit a complete sample.
Explicit BF16 dtype now reaches loader; ordinary image profiles retain auto; paired worker verifies actual model dtype.
intentional_image_adaptations: Use MileBench still images, source JPEG/prompts/pixel/truncation, 512 generated tokens instead of video64frames/128tokens.
Use image absolute BUDGET512 with independent RATIO0.1, not the video fallback1024; per-arm effective budgets remain native.
Use original Spot Rouge-L and MMCoQA substring Accuracy, not WUPS; no unsupported image confidence interval or independent-input claim.
Fresh-output fail-fast execution; exact resume is not implemented.
